answer:
The predecessor of the longest-reigning British monarch, **Queen Elizabeth II**, was her father, **King George VI**.

Queen Elizabeth II reigned for 70 years and 214 days, surpassing the previous record held by Queen Victoria. She became monarch on February 6, 1952, upon her father's death, and served until her own passing on September 8, 2022.
